liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Feel Like A Stranger** (2 reviews): Stranger into Brown Eyed Women made a nice opener; Reviewer found the Stranger opener incredible [11][15]
- **Bird Song** (2 reviews): Reviewer names Bird Song as their highlight; First set smoked, especially Stranger and Bird Song [11][18]
- **Way To Go Home** (2 reviews): Jerry ripped on Way To Go Home; Vince sounded excellent and sang in tune on Way to Go Home [15][17]
- **Terrapin Station** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls the Terrapin superb; Terrapin was so intense that it triggered a flashback and anxiety attack for the sober listener [9][12]
- **Lazy River road** (1 review): Reviewer praises Lazy River Road [15]
- **Aiko-Aiko** (1 review): A very long, hot Aiko opened the second set [18]
- **Space** (1 review): Space was extended and especially out there, partly credited to Dan Healey for the spacey start [17]
- **The Days Between** (1 review): Reviewer found The Days Between very nice [16]

## The recordings

- **gd1993-06-26.127688.Boedicker.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 19 songs; 177 min [1]. Said about its sound: Uploader rates the quality about A-, subjective, with samples included [1]
- **gd1993-06-26.sbd.miller.110520.flac16**: soundboard; 18 songs; 176 min; rated 3/5 by 4 [2]
- **gd93-06-26.ams.keyser.26279.sbefail.flac16**: audience recording; 18 songs; 177 min; rated 4.33/5 by 3 [3]
- **gd1993-06-26.149338.fob.schoeps521.ebel.flac16**: source not stated; 18 songs; 173 min [4]

## Around the show

- Bobby's voice was scratchy because he was about to have surgery to remove polyps from his throat [9]
- Bruce Hornsby played piano as a guest throughout the show [9]
- Reviewer recalls the day as rainy, though the weather didn't dampen the experience [10]
- Reviewer recalls Jerry playing Walking on the Moon with Sting [11]
- Hornsby's squeezebox at the end of the first set disappointed this reviewer [14]
- Reviewer mentions Garcia playing Walking on the Moon with Sting and would love to hear it [14]
- Bobby sang through the show with a raspy throat [17]
- Playin'-Terrapin lasted about 35 minutes, enhanced by visuals on huge screens above the stage [18]
- This Playin' and Terrapin pairing is among the hottest of the later years, running about thirty minutes [16]
- Reviewer thinks it far surpasses the other RFK show that year [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1993-06-26.127688.Boedicker.flac16**: taped by Dave Boedicker; transferred by Dave Boedicker; source: Source: Sony D6 Cassette Master>Nakamichi 300 Mics W/CP4 Shotguns>Sony TC-D5M Cassette Deck(Playback)> Edirol R-09 HR(24/44.1 KHZ)>Cd Wav Editor>Traders Little… [1]. Also: Transfer from a DAT source, with some edits and flips, and minor cuts at tape flips [1]
- **gd1993-06-26.sbd.miller.110520.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Dat (48k) [2]
- **gd93-06-26.ams.keyser.26279.sbefail.flac16**: taped by James Young and Ron Keyser; transferred by Ron Keyser; source: Audience: AMS ST250 [3]
- **gd1993-06-26.149338.fob.schoeps521.ebel.flac16**: taped by Unknown; transferred by Pete Ebel; source: FOB Schoeps CMC 5 MK 21-> DAT [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1993-06-25 Robert F. Kennedy Stadium, Washington, DC, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1993-06-25-robert-f-kennedy-stadium-washington-dc-usa/) [22]
- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1993-06-26 Grateful Dead Ticket - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1993-06-26-grateful-dead-ticket/) [23]
- Poster by Sameh Tawfik Grateful Dead: [1993-06-26 Robert F. Kennedy Stadium, Washington, DC, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1993-06-26-robert-f-kennedy-stadium-washington-dc-usa/) [24]
